recommendation: Keep this source fix. It preserves the applied FHIR-36858 mechanism while removing the obsolete one-code terminology and example code that no longer match the current binding. Do not decide FHIR-55950 here because it is a later Triaged, unresolved proposal about the comparison model.
issue_request: FHIR-36858 was a Published FHIR-core O&O change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification for R5. It requested a way for Procedure or DiagnosticReport to reference relevant prior, comparison, baseline, or related studies/reports; the approved resolution made DiagnosticReport.supportingInfo a backbone element with a required type and reference, initially using an example binding to HL7 v2 Table 0936.
initial_application: The issue was initially applied by f897eb6959c75fabf78584f94981bafac6e94fca, which added DiagnosticReport.supportingInfo, its type/reference children, a one-code local diagnosticreport-supportinginfo-type terminology, and a gingival-biopsy example using the local historical code. Commit 3c4e05e24c0aba397e142f44a8f9688e8ab0f683 completed the Jira-commented binding correction by changing supportingInfo.type to v2-0936 and deleting the local ValueSet, but the local CodeSystem and historical example code remained.
additional_context: DiagnosticReport is active in source/fhir.ini, and the gingival-biopsy example is included in source/diagnosticreport/list-DiagnosticReport-examples.xml, so the touched source files are in build scope. Later Applied issues refined the model: FHIR-48391 replaced the v2-0936 binding with diagnosticreport-relevant-information-types derived from v2-0936/v2-0937 and added PHX for Patient History; FHIR-48389 added DiagnosticReport.comparison and clarified that supportingInfo should not duplicate resources referenced elsewhere. Both later issues already have reconcile commits on the combined branch.
reconciliation: This commit deleted the obsolete source/diagnosticreport/codesystem-diagnosticreport-supportinginfo-type.xml file and updated source/diagnosticreport/diagnosticreport-example-gingival-biopsy.xml so its supportingInfo.type coding uses http://hl7.org/fhir/diagnosticreport-relevant-information-types#PHX with display Patient History. The existing DiagnosticReport StructureDefinition already contains the supportingInfo backbone/reference and later comparison guidance, so no structural edit was needed.
source_changes: Deleted source/diagnosticreport/codesystem-diagnosticreport-supportinginfo-type.xml because the local historical CodeSystem was superseded by the FHIR-36858 v2-0936 binding correction and later FHIR-48391 relevant-information terminology.

Updated source/diagnosticreport/diagnosticreport-example-gingival-biopsy.xml supportingInfo.type from the stale historical code to the current diagnosticreport-relevant-information-types PHX code with explicit system and display.
